name: theroo ushta
text: theroo ushta is a Manx-Gaelic spelling for the Manx water-bull. The form stands as a variant of tarroo ushtey, the standard modern spelling. MacKillop records it as an epithet of the Gaulish Mars in the intermediate tradition. The principal record sits under tarroo-ushtey.

attributes.attribute: Manx-Gaelic variant spelling of the Manx water-bull; pointer to tarroo-ushtey

okr.objective: theroo ushta is a MacKillop variant-signpost to tarroo-ushtey.
